purpose: Compile a Multiwrite manuscript into a governed Doré BookModel, EditorialReport and BookBuild before publication artifacts are emitted.

editorial_gate.blocked_when: hard structural or metadata errors prevent a valid book build
editorial_gate.review_required_when: authorial judgment is required but a working artifact may still be exported
editorial_gate.ready_when: no hard blocker or unresolved authorial-decision issue is detected

publication_boundary.rule: Public artifact projections must be allowlisted; never spread BookModel wholesale into publication metadata or manifests.
